title: Better Hardcore Datapack
description: Completely overhauls Hardcore mode to be true danger.
body:
Better Hardcore is a datapack that aims to increase the general game difficulty to be harder. Perfect for those who think Minecraft no longer feels hard anymore!

**⚠️ ATTENTION. This data pack is dependent on its [Resource Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bh-rp)! ⚠️**

![Welcome to Better Hardcore.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9013950e98c6207b78250d85b36efe8b4837f992.webp)

## ⚙️ Installation Guide
1. Prepare the creation of a new world in hardcore mode.
2. Select data packs, open the temporary drop file folder and drop the _BH_DP.zip_ file there. Then, enable it.
3. Open resource packs from settings, click on add a new resource pack and drop the _BH_RP.zip_ file. Then, enable it.
4. Start the creation of the new world with Better Hardcore loaded in. You should receive a message when entering the game.
5. Have fun!

## What does this data pack add?
**🧟 MOB CHANGES OVERVIEW**
- All general mobs are stronger, faster and better.
- Creepers' fuse time is much lower.
- Pillagers now have quick charge III and multishot crossbows, and skeletons power II bows.
- Spiders are really fast, create cobwebs on first-time player collision and on death.
- The creaking does a lot of damage compared to vanilla, which makes it much more similar to the Warden.
- Phantoms are now a literal nightmare.

**✨ POWERFUL ENEMY STATE**
- They are overpowered enemies that have much more life and show cool particles.
- Drop Powerful Relics, which can be used to temporally get maximum energy.

**🕹️ PLAYER CHANGES**
- The default health is five hearts, but it can be upgraded with Life Lights, a new item.
- The addition of Energy, which nerfs running and jumping.

![Stamina bar & Reduced Max. Health](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00c71e675d1870d96055e93037078464905db642.webp)

**🏞️ WORLD & MISC CHANGES**
- Extremely dark caves. Don't use gamma, cheater!
- Encountering Life Lights to regenerate maximum health back to normal.
- Trading with villagers will begin a raid after trading many times.

![Extremely Dark Caves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8cbbbe36e9c1855653e901770ef5aeb1179a0a21.webp)

## Tips & Tricks to Survive more than a day!﻿
**RECOMMENDED IF YOU HAVE TROUBLES ON THE FIRST DAY!**

- Every minute is useful.
- Stay away from the caves close to you and anywhere dark a mob could spawn.
- Avoid the underground until you are really well protected with the armor you can get.
- Go to Ancient Cities and try to find Life Lights on chests to recover health. Trial Chambers and Treasure Bastions are also an option, however they have more hostile mobs.
- Craft torches in campfires with sticks to light up the place.
- Defeat Powerful Mobs to have maximum energy for a period of time.
- Always sleep; a single phantom can be deadly if unprepared.
- Settle in ocean, or biomes with fewer hostile mobs.
- Totems of Undying are and will be your best friend.
